note: Dark Mode Toggle provides one Block plugin (dark_mode_toggle) and a theme hook; it has no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no config schema. Its only persistent site state is the block placement (a block config entity with plugin dark_mode_toggle). The JS toggles data-dmt-mode (dark|light) and data-dmt-source (user|system) on <html> and stores the choice in localStorage key 'dmt-mode'. Introspection/execution cases are therefore grounded in real block placements; easy cases in the real attribute/localStorage contract.

evals.prompt: The Drupal contrib module dark_mode_toggle switches a theme between light and dark. Which HTML attribute does its JavaScript set on the <html> element to indicate the active variant, and what are its two possible values?
evals.expected_output: It sets data-dmt-mode on the <html> (documentElement) to either 'dark' or 'light'. It also sets data-dmt-source to 'user' or 'system'. The theme's CSS styles the page off the data-dmt-mode attribute.

evals.prompt: In the dark_mode_toggle module, how is a visitor's Light/Dark choice remembered between page loads, and what happens when they pick the 'System' button?
evals.expected_output: A manual Light/Dark choice is stored in the browser under localStorage key 'dmt-mode' (source=user). Picking System removes that key and follows the OS prefers-color-scheme media query (source=system), updating live when the OS preference changes.

evals.prompt: I installed dark_mode_toggle but there is no settings page. How do I actually add the light/dark switcher to my Drupal site, and what makes the page actually change colour?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route. You place the 'Dark Mode Toggle' block (plugin id dark_mode_toggle) in a region via Structure > Block layout. The module only toggles the data-dmt-mode attribute on <html>; the active theme's CSS must actually restyle the page based on [data-dmt-mode=dark].

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Dark Mode Toggle block has been placed in the Olivero theme. Inspect the live block configuration and state which region the dark_mode_toggle block is placed in.
evals.expected_output: The block.block.dmt_eval_known placement (plugin dark_mode_toggle, theme olivero) is in the 'sidebar' region.

evals.prompt: Is the Dark Mode Toggle switcher actually active on this site's front end, and if so under what block plugin id? Inspect the live block placements to answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — there is an enabled block placement whose plugin is dark_mode_toggle (block.block.dmt_eval_known in the olivero sidebar region), so the toggle renders on the front end.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the Dark Mode Toggle switcher appear on the front end by placing its block in a region of the default Olivero theme. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity with plugin dark_mode_toggle in an Olivero region (e.g. block.block.* with theme=olivero, region=content, plugin=dark_mode_toggle, status=true) via Block layout or drush/config.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, put the dark/light mode switcher specifically in the Sidebar of the Olivero theme so it shows in that region. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Place the dark_mode_toggle block in the olivero 'sidebar' region: a block config entity with theme=olivero, region=sidebar, plugin=dark_mode_toggle, status=true.
